{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Austria|Austrian]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

This is the original '''Sachertorte''' recipe, obtained through the courtesy of Mrs Anna Sacher.<ref>[Viennese Cooking, O. & A. Hess, adapted for American use [Crown Publishing: New York] 1952 (p. 229)]</ref>

==Ingredients==
===Cake===
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (170 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 6 ½ [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (180 g) semi-sweet [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]]
* ¾ cup (170 g) white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 8 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]] yolks
* 1 cup (120 g) [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 10 [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg whites]], stiffly [[Cookbook:Whipping|whipped]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tbsp|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Apricot|apricot]] [[Cookbook:Jam|jam]]

===Icing===
* 1 cup (225 g) white granulated sugar
* ⅓ cup (80 ml) water
* 7 oz (200 g) semi-sweet chocolate

==Procedure==
# Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|275°F (140°C)]].
# [[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] butter until creamy. 
# Melt chocolate. Add sugar and chocolate to butter; stir.
# Add egg yolks one at a time. Add flour. [[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] in egg whites. Grease and butter 8–9-inch [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake tin]]. Pour mixture in.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in oven about 1 hour. Test with [[Cookbook:Skewer|toothpick]] or straw. Remove to a board; cool. 
# Cook sugar and water to a thin thread.
# Melt chocolate in top of double boiler.
# Add sugar syrup gradually to chocolate. Stir constantly until icing coats the spoon.
# Cut the top off of cake and turn bottom up.
# Heat apricot jam slightly and spread over cake. Cover with the chocolate icing.
